# dsh-cc-auto-memory
**Claude Code's auto memory, packaged as a lightweight plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): persistent
, file-based memory.**
At the start of each session, memory-usage instructions and the `MEMORY.md` index are injected autom
atically; the model manages memory files with the plain `read` / `write` / `edit` tools — no dedicat
ed memory tools are registered. The on-disk format is identical to Claude Code's, so memories are di
rectly interoperable between the two (`claude` mode even shares the exact same directory).
## Installation
Web (CLI):
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Desktop: open the in-app **Plugins** page and search for `dsh-cc-auto-memory`.
## Mechanism
A faithful port of Claude Code's native auto memory — see the official docs for the original mechani
sm. Per session it works like this:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

- Subagent sessions get no main-session memory injected (same as Claude Code).
- Project resolution:
git repository root (cwd when outside a repo), `/` → `-` in the slug; one shared memory per reposit
repository root (cwd when outside a repo), `/` → `-` in the slug; one shared memory per repository.
## Viewer panel
Settings → Auto Memory (read-only viewing; editing/creating/deleting is left to the agent's file too
ls during a session):
- **Storage mode**: two mode cards (dsh standalone directory / claude reuse) plus an "Apply switch"

button — switching only takes effect for new sessions:
- `dsh` (default): `$DSH_HOME/projects/<slug>

/memory/`
- `claude`: `~/.claude/projects/<slug>/memory/` (`CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` respected) — shares t
he same memory with Claude Code, interoperable both ways
> In claude mode, the model's write/edit calls into `~/.claude/` fall outside the session workspace

and trigger approvals per the session sandbox policy — this is expected.
- **Project list filtered b
y the active mode**: dsh mode shows only projects under `$DSH_HOME`; claude mode shows only projects

under `~/.claude`
- **Memory table**: **click any row to open a floating card** showing the raw fil
e content (plain text, Markdown not rendered); Esc or clicking the overlay closes it
## Configuration
`cordis.patch.yml` can be overridden at the user layer:
| Field | Default | Description |

| `mode` | `dsh` | Storage mode `dsh` / `claude` |
| `claudeConfigDir` | `''` | Claude Code config r

oot for claude mode; empty = `$CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` or `~/.claude` |
| `maxIndexLines` | `200` | Line

limit when reading `MEMORY.md` |
| `maxIndexBytes` | `25600` | Byte limit when reading `MEMORY.md` |
